title: After Rippling Blew Millions On Ai In Months It Built An Employee Roi Tool
report:

AI Spend Console maps employee AI usage and identifies areas where costs can be optimized. By using this tool, companies can negotiate better rates with AI providers and reduce waste.

**Key Facts:**

1. Rippling's AI Spend Console is designed to help companies contain their AI spending by tracking individual employee, team, and role-level usage.
2. The tool was developed after Rippling itself experienced 80% month-over-month growth in AI token expenses, which threatened to burn through 40% of its R&D headcount budget.
3. Rippling's analysis found that 10-15% of employees were driving 60% of total AI spend, with one engineer spending $50,000 per month on AI tokens.

title: Apple Watch Heart Rate App Feature Didnt Realize Existed
report:
**Summary:**

The Apple Watch has a built-in electrocardiogram (ECG) feature that allows users to take more in-depth readings of their heart health. This feature is available on Apple Watches Series 4 or later, excluding SE models, and provides a more detailed picture of the heart's electrical signals than the standard heart rate monitor. The ECG app can be accessed through the Health app on the iPhone and set up on the Apple Watch to take readings. However, it's essential to note that this feature is not designed to detect heart attack symptoms and should not replace medical attention if issues arise.

**Key Facts:**

1. **Availability:** The ECG app is available on all Apple Watches Series 4 or later (excluding SE models) and all Ultra models.
2. **Setup:** To use the ECG app, users must update to the latest version of watchOS and iOS, then download the app through the Health app on their iPhone.
3. **Taking a reading:** Users can take an ECG reading by opening the ECG app on their Apple Watch, resting their arms in a relaxed position, and holding their finger on the Digital Crown for 30 seconds.
4. **Interpreting results:** Results may vary slightly depending on the version of the ECG app, which is determined by regional regulations.
5. **Limitations:** The ECG feature is not designed to detect heart attack symptoms and should not replace medical attention if issues arise; users are advised to consult a doctor if they experience any concerns about their heart health.

title: Teenage Sex And Death At Camp Miasma Jack Haven Little Death Bloody One Take Dance
